forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {漲|みなぎ}っていませんでした

definitions.explanation: to be filled with and overflowing; to be brimming with (energy, emotion, etc.)

examples.japanese: ⟦{活力|かつりょく}→活力：05525_katsuryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{漲|みなぎ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{漲|みなぎ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。

⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{闘志|とうし}→闘志：19440_toushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{漲|みなぎ}った⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧。
examples.english: The players faced the match with expressions brimming with fighting spirit.

notes:
{漲|みなぎ}る is an intransitive godan verb describing a state of being filled to overflowing with something, typically energy or emotion.

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧).

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally described water rising and overflowing (⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ + なぎる from ⟦{満|み}ちる→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧), now primarily used figuratively.

USAGE:
- Almost always used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark what one is filled with
- Pattern: ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{漲|みなぎ}る (to be overflowing with ~)
- Describes a powerful, dynamic state of fullness
- Strongly positive and dynamic
- Suggests energy that can barely be contained
- Often used for inspirational or dramatic descriptions

REGISTER: Neutral to slightly literary. Common in sports commentary and inspirational writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{活力|かつりょく}→活力：05525_katsuryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{漲|みなぎ}る (overflowing with vitality)
- ⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{漲|みなぎ}る (brimming with confidence)
- ⟦{闘志|とうし}→闘志：19440_toushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{漲|みなぎ}る (filled with fighting spirit)
- {若|わか}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{漲|みなぎ}る (overflowing with youthfulness)
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{漲|みなぎ}る (to be filled with power)
